name: Tayyab Shahzad

hero.headline: I build the software your business runs on.
hero.valueProposition: Websites, dashboards, business systems, SaaS products, APIs, and AI tools — designed, built, and deployed end to end. From campaign platforms to a live restaurant ordering system.

image.alt: Portrait of Tayyab Shahzad, full-stack developer

about.who: I'm Tayyab, a full-stack developer from Pakistan. I build complete software products — the interface people use, the API behind it, the database, and the deployment that keeps it running.
about.interestedIn: I start from the business problem, not the tech stack. Before writing code, I make sure I understand who will use the software, what has to work on day one, and what can wait. You get clear written scope, regular progress you can click through, and code you fully own.
about.whatIBuild: My main production work is Krunchies: the ordering website, staff point of sale, and admin system a pizza restaurant runs on, with an offline-capable POS and a Go backend. I also build Python backends that use language models, tools, and knowledge-base search.
about.headingTowards: I'm studying Computer Science at Namal University and taking on freelance projects alongside it. I'm looking for clients who want dependable software built carefully, explained clearly, and delivered on an agreed scope.

footer.statement: Full-stack developer building websites, business systems, SaaS products, APIs, and AI tools for clients worldwide.

contact.headline: Let's talk about your project
contact.subheadline: Tell me what you want to build or what problem you need solved. I reply within 24 hours with questions, a suggested approach, and next steps.
contact.note: A short description is enough to start: what the software should do, who will use it, and any deadline or budget range you have in mind.

seo.title: Tayyab Shahzad — Full-Stack Developer for Business Software, SaaS & AI Tools
seo.description: Full-stack developer building websites, POS and business systems, dashboards, SaaS MVPs, APIs, and AI-powered tools. Creator of the Krunchies restaurant ordering and POS platform.

credibility: One developer, from database to deployment
